title: The Power of 15-Minute Daily Habits
passage_text: Learning a new language does not require three hours of exhausting study every day. Research shows that just fifteen minutes of consistent daily practice yields significantly better results. When you practice daily, your brain retains vocabulary and grammar patterns naturally. Start by listening to a 5-minute English podcast in the morning and learning five new words before bedtime. Small daily improvements accumulate into extraordinary speaking fluency over time.

title: Chennai's Thriving Tech & Innovation Ecosystem
passage_text: Chennai has transformed into one of India's foremost hubs for software development, SaaS companies, and deep-tech innovation. Engineers and entrepreneurs across Tamil Nadu are creating software solutions used by millions of global customers. Strong English communication skills have become a vital prerequisite for tech professionals to collaborate with international clients, participate in global standups, and present product architectures with clarity and precision.
